name: Sufyan ibn Sa'id al-Thawri
nameAr: سفيان بن سعيد بن مسروق الثوري الكوفي

laqab.en: Commander of the Faithful in hadith

nisbas.en: al-Thawri, of Thawr ibn Abd Manat

bornNote: Reckoned from the Taqrib (died 161 aged 64); the rijal works give 95, 96 or 97
diedNote: 161 AH in Basra, where he had gone into hiding (Taqrib); other reports give 159, 160 or 162

deathVariants.authority: other reports collected in the rijal works

taqrib.ar: ثقة حافظ فقيه عابد إمام حجة، من رؤوس الطبقة السابعة، وكان ربما دلس
taqrib.en: Reliable, a hadith master, jurist and worshipper, an imam and a proof; one of the heads of the seventh generation. He would sometimes use the ambiguous formula.

role: Imam of Kufa; one of the two Sufyans

teachers.name: Hammad ibn Zayd
teachers.source: reciprocal of the entry in hammad-ibn-zayd's record (Tahdhib al-Tahdhib: 'and al-Thawri, who is older than he')

teachers.name: Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid
teachers.source: reciprocal of the entry in ismail-ibn-abi-khalid's record (Tahdhib al-Tahdhib ('the two Sufyans'))

students.name: Abdullah ibn al-Mubarak
students.source: Shamela narrator record 2472 (companions named: Ibn al-Mubarak, Waki', Abu Ishaq al-Fazari, Ibn Mahdi)

students.name: Yahya al-Qattan
students.source: reciprocal of the entry in yahya-ibn-said-al-qattan's record (Tahdhib al-Tahdhib)

verdicts.critic: Shu'ba, Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, Abu Asim al-Nabil and Yahya ibn Ma'in
verdicts.en: Sufyan is the Commander of the Faithful in hadith.

verdicts.ar: ما رأيت أحدا أحفظ من سفيان الثوري
verdicts.en: I have seen no one with a better memory than Sufyan al-Thawri.

verdicts.ar: سفيان فقيه حافظ زاهد، إمام أهل العراق، وأتقن أصحاب أبي إسحاق، وهو أحفظ من شعبة، وإذا اختلف الثوري وشعبة فالثوري
verdicts.en: Sufyan is a jurist, a hadith master and an ascetic, the imam of the people of Iraq, the most precise of Abu Ishaq's students; he has a better memory than Shu'ba, and when al-Thawri and Shu'ba differ, al-Thawri is preferred. He also named him the firmest of al-A'mash's students.

verdicts.ar: لم يكن أحد أعلم بحديث أبي إسحاق من الثوري، وكان يدلس، ولم يكن أحد أعلم بحديث الأعمش من الثوري
verdicts.en: No one knew Abu Ishaq's hadith better than al-Thawri, and he would use the ambiguous formula; and no one knew al-A'mash's hadith better than al-Thawri.

verdicts.source: Ibn Hajar, Ta'rif Ahl al-Taqdis, entry 51

verdicts.ar: ما رأيت أحفظ للحديث من الثوري
verdicts.en: I have seen no one with a better memory for hadith than al-Thawri.

dhahabi.en: One of the leading authorities in learning and asceticism.

tadlis.source: Ibn Hajar, Ta'rif Ahl al-Taqdis (Tabaqat al-Mudallisin), entry 51, second rank: described as a mudallis by al-Nasa'i and others; al-Bukhari: how little his tadlis is
tadlis.note: The second rank holds those whose ambiguous formula the imams tolerated because of their standing and because they rarely used it, or used it only over reliable narrators. Here he says 'from al-A'mash'. The class notes report finding no route in which Sufyan states explicit hearing of this hadith; this record does not verify that search. Ibn Hajar notes that Sufyan also carries Umar's words by a second chain, through Ibrahim ibn Abd al-A'la from Suwayd ibn Ghafla, which Muslim records (1271).

bio: The imam of Kufa in the generation of Malik and Shu'ba, called the Commander of the Faithful in hadith by his own peers; Ibn Mahdi and Yahya al-Qattan, who knew every master of the age, said they had met no one with a better memory. He fled the Abbasid court to Makkah and then Basra, where he died in hiding in 161 AH. The critics note that he occasionally used the ambiguous formula, but al-Bukhari remarked how rarely, and Ibn Hajar places him in the tolerated second rank.
